name: Joshua Slaughter
bottom_line: A labor leader's biography with big record claims from his years as a county legislative aide. The sewer district is real but cost about $224 million from federal, state and county money. He was a staffer, so "helped secure" is a share of a large collective effort.
findings: The Forge River sewer district was first proposed by his former boss, Legislator Kate Browning, in 2006.
The open-space and labor-policy claims have no figures or sources on the page.
page_issues: Says he gained Assembly experience without naming the role or dates.
